dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides many concrete numbers (Fargate pricing, Spot discount up to 90%, Karpenter 20‑40% savings, CSP discount ranges) and a detailed decision framework, but a large portion restates publicly documented AWS cost facts without novel decision trees or proprietary thresholds, limiting the true expert delta.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes AWS‑specific procedures: exact CLI commands for data gathering (aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics, aws eks describe-nodegroup), node‑group inventory extraction with jq, Spot readiness checklist (PDB, NTH, multi‑AZ), Karpenter migration steps, Savings Plan purchase syntax, and a mandatory CONFIRM gate before any state‑changing operation.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a detailed NEVER list with five concrete anti‑patterns and explicit why‑clauses (e.g., never downsize without checking requests/usage ratio, never recommend Fargate with DaemonSets, never use Spot without PDB and graceful drain, never claim Savings Plan on Fargate, never use a single instance type for Spot/Karpenter).

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Full front‑matter, clear description, WHEN‑TO‑USE / WHEN‑NOT‑TO‑USE sections, exhaustive activation_triggers, precise invocation_schema, and a strict output contract with required fields. An agent can reliably decide when to invoke the skill.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Information is layered: Quick start → Mindset → Quick reference → Pre‑flight → Process → Output format → Heuristics → NEVER → Deep references. Critical rules (CONFIRM, safety checks) are highlighted early; detailed CLI snippets are deferred to reference sections, avoiding cognitive overload.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions (node‑group updates, Karpenter install) are tightly constrained by a mandatory CONFIRM prompt, batch‑size limit, and pre‑flight safety checks. Analytic or classification tasks are left freer, matching task fragility.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (Quick start → Mindset → Process → Output contract → Heuristics → NEVER → References) that aligns with the standard skill template used across the repository.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides decision trees, CLI examples, and migration steps, but the model output examples violate the output contract by omitting required sub‑fields (e.g., missing "Monthly (compute model)" in several blocks) and sometimes skip the "Pricing model" line. Edge cases such as mixed EC2 + Fargate clusters or multi‑AZ spot capacity scoring are not fully covered, limiting reliable cold execution.
